expansion_extra.description: Rows are US apartment rental classified adverts collected in 2019 from rental listing sites; the target is the monthly rental price in USD.
expansion_extra.note: 10K published partition used; the archive also ships a 100K variant, UCI lists 10,000 instances
expansion_extra.provenance: UCI ML Repository, Apartment for Rent Classified (id 555), donated 2019 by A. Blattner; classifieds harvested from US apartment listing sites (RentLingo, RentDigs.com and others).

sampling.method: quota stratified by target / grouped / native split
